summary: Full backend + frontend testing of iteration-2 features: admin JWT auth, change-password, Word import preview/commit, exam materi_stats, Rapor API/UI. 25/25 backend pytest tests pass (16 new feature tests + 9 regression). Admin UI: Change Password tab works (rules validation, success toast); Unggah Word tab works (file upload, preview report with mcq=100/essay=25/all-ok, target picker pre-selects matching C2 subject, new-subject mode fields render, Batal reset). Rapor UI: dashboard-report-button present, navbar Rapor link, report-empty shown for untested levels, level-avg/best/attempts/passed cards, weakest-materi section, subject-report-{id} cards with toggle-materi expand/materi-bars, no horizontal overflow at 390px.

minor.issue: Password rule enforces len>=10, which blocks restoring to the seeded '<ADMIN_PASSWORD>' (8 chars) via API. Review-request step 'MUST restore password back to <ADMIN_PASSWORD> at the end' is only possible by direct DB write. Consider either (a) relaxing length to >=8 to match the seed default, or (b) updating the seed/.env to use a >=10 char default and documenting restore procedure.

action_items: Decide whether the admin password minimum should be lowered to 8 so .env default <ADMIN_PASSWORD> can be restored via the API (currently only possible via direct Mongo write).
No functional fixes required for iteration-2 features.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py password_problem(): minimum 10 chars conflicts with the seeded default '<ADMIN_PASSWORD>' (8 chars). Any admin who changes then wants to go back is blocked. Suggest aligning seed default and policy.
server.py submit_exam: materi_stats are computed only when a question has a 'materi' field — Tingkat A banks currently have none, so A rapor correctly shows the empty state. Documented, not a bug.
import_commit: when `mcq` list in draft is empty, essays-only files would skip deleting existing PGs (correct behavior reflected in `mcq_kept` flag). Good design.

frontend Report.jsx: uses `getReport().catch(() => setData({...}))` — a failing /report request would show the untested-level empty state silently. Minor UX improvement opportunity (show error toast).
frontend ImportWord.jsx: `canSave` does not block saving when mcq_valid=0 AND essay_valid=0 due to issues (`report.mcq_valid > 0 || report.essay_valid > 0` guard present — OK).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (Rapor empty/loaded, Change-Password panel, Import Word preview + target + reset)

test_credentials: Admin password <ADMIN_PASSWORD> via POST /api/admin/login (restored to <ADMIN_PASSWORD> via direct Mongo write at end of tests). Candidate: name on /dashboard. Pre-exam tokens: USKP2026, CAT-A1, KEMENKEU.
seed_data_creation: Created a few test results under candidate_id prefix 'TEST_' and candidate_name 'TEST_*'. Cleaned up at end (15 TEST_ results removed, 0 TEST_ subjects remained because test_commit_new_subject_and_delete already deletes created subject in its own teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py = Tingkat A/B regression. test_new_features.py = iteration-2 features (auth, change-password, import, materi_stats, report). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; use `-n 0` for serial. ADMIN password rule >=10 chars blocks setting <ADMIN_PASSWORD> via API — if your test rotates it, restore via Mongo: update admin_users password_hash with bcrypt hash of '<ADMIN_PASSWORD>' and reset token_version to 0 (code snippet in test_change_password_full_flow).
rca of the issue: No defects. One policy/UX inconsistency noted: password_problem() minimum of 10 characters does not permit restoring to the seeded 8-char default <ADMIN_PASSWORD> via the change-password endpoint.
